verdict.rationale: Bland documents an official Web Agent SDK for embedding voice agents in React, Vanilla JS, or Node apps, with server-side auth handling, plus an official CLI listed under its /sdks section. The evidence does not show general-purpose API client SDKs for driving calls, pathways, and agents from code, and no OpenAPI spec was found for generating clients. Missing for 10: general-purpose server-side API SDKs (e.g. Python/Node clients for calls, pathways, agents), a published OpenAPI spec, SDK reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
